messages:
Priya (oncall): Hot: seeing a spike in 503s for realtimev3 across us-west-2. Grafana -> https://grafana/redwood/realtimev3/errors. Can we flip an emergency route to fallback at 10% canary while we triage? Who's authorized and what's the exact command?

Ben: I'm available. prefer routing to model-v2-small fallback instead of full kill. agree on 10% canary. Need to know authorized list and we should record reason in audit.

Alex: @Ben FYI only SRE + eng-oncall can flip emergency toggles (see runbook). OpsBot will emit audit entries. Runbook ref: runbooks/FF-004-emergency-disable.

Priya (oncall): I'm oncall and I approve doing a canary route to fallback. Ben, drop the CLI you'll run and I'll ack.

Ben: Will run the following to set canary and route:
```
# route realtimev3 traffic to fallback model-v2-small at 10% canary
ffctl set realtimev3.route.fallback=model-v2-small --canary=10 --reason "Spike 503s 2001234567"
```
I'll tag the change and add notes to the incident doc.

Priya (oncall): Approved. @OpsBot please tag audit: approved-by=Priya.

OpsBot: ACTION LOG: flip_prepared by Ben; awaiting execution. Audit ID: AUD-2001. :white_check_mark:

Ben: Executing now...
```
ffctl apply realtimev3 --from-change realtimev3.route.fallback
```
Done — canary is set to 10% and routed to model-v2-small. Observability shows initial drop in error-rate for a subset.

Sam (SRE): Monitoring: lowered alert thresholds and added a temporary dashboard for realtimev3 errors. Splunk query added: `index=realtimev3 "503" | timeslice 1m | stats count by _time`. I'll keep an eye for 15m.

Priya (oncall): Good. Keep the canary for 30m and reassess. If recovery, we rollback canary to 0% then reintroduce slowly. If not, we'll escalate to full cutoff + paging.

Alex: Documented steps in the incident doc (#incidents/2001234567). Please append timestamps and the who/what. OpsBot will append audit entry as well.

OpsBot: AUDIT APPEND: flip executed by Ben at ts=2001234590; prev_state=normal; new_state=canary-10%; audit_id=AUD-2001.

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll add the ffctl output and a short timeline to the incident doc now.

Priya (oncall): One follow-up: add a clear 2nd-line list in the runbook for who can flip when Sam is unavailable. Also note: full 100% kill requires Eng Director sign-off unless this is classified P1. Call me first for any full cutoff.

Alex: Roger. I'll update runbooks/FF-004 to include Ben, Priya, Sam and the escalation path to Eng Manager -> Eng Director.

Priya (oncall): Thanks team. Closing the loop here; we'll reconvene after the 30m check.

Ben: Acknowledged.
